name: Florida Mesh (MediumFast, southeast coast and Jacksonville)
area: Southeast coast from Sebastian to Layton Key (Monroe through Okeechobee counties); Jacksonville and Duval County

mqtt.advice: Florida Mesh runs its own MQTT server, which now requires an account; see their MQTT page.

notes: Their page says to leave the frequency slot on 0 (automatic), which is slot 45 with the default channel name. Set 45 by hand only if you rename the primary channel.
Jacksonville and Duval County moved to MediumFast on 2026-03-28; the southeast coast moved in 2026.
Brevard County is listed as a dual LongFast and MediumFast area.
